3.t: Proclaim the greatness of your Lord;

6.t: do not be overwhelmed and weaken;

7.t: be steadfast in your Lord’s cause.

9.t: that will be a Day of anguish for the disbelievers.

11.t: [Prophet], leave Me to deal with the one I created helpless,

15.t: yet he still hopes I will give him more.

16.t: No! He has been stubbornly hostile to Our revelation:

17.t: I will inflict a spiralling torment on him.

23.t: and turned away and behaved arrogantly

24.t: and said, ‘This is just old sorcery,

25.t: just the talk of a mortal!’

26.t: I will throw him into the scorching Fire.

27.t: What will explain to you what the scorching Fire is?

28.t: It spares nothing and leaves nothing;

29.t: it scorches the flesh of humans;

30.t: there are nineteen in charge of it––

31.t: none other than angels appointed by Us to guard Hellfire- and We have made their number a test for the disbelievers. So those who have been given the Scripture will be certain and those who believe will have their faith increased: neither those who have been given the Scripture nor the believers will have any doubts, but the sick at heart and the disbelievers will say, ‘What could God mean by this description?’ God leaves whoever He will to stray and guides whoever He will- no one knows your Lord’s forces except Him- this [description] is a warning to mortals.

35.t: It is one of the mightiest things,

37.t: to those of you who choose to go ahead and those who lag behind.

38.t: Every soul is held in pledge for its deeds,

39.t: but the Companions of the Right will stay

42.t: ‘What drove you to the Scorching Fire?’ [they will ask]

43.t: and they will answer, ‘We did not pray;

44.t: we did not feed the poor;

45.t: we indulged with others [in mocking the believers];

46.t: we denied the Day of Judgement

47.t: until the Certain End came upon us.’

48.t: No intercessor’s plea will benefit them now.

49.t: What is the matter with them? Why do they turn away from the warning,

52.t: Each one of them demands that a scripture be sent down to him and unrolled before his very eyes-

53.t: No! Truly they have no fear of the life to come-

54.t: but truly this is a reminder.

55.t: Let whoever wishes to take heed do so:

56.t: they will only take heed if God so wishes. He is the Lord who should be heeded, the Lord of forgiveness.
